answer: Before an identity earns any grading weight, it must bond a refundable deposit of 500 governance tokens, held on-ledger like cargo locked at a wharf until the voyage proves sound. Each epoch, verifiers sample that agent's grades against a quorum-weighted consensus; when divergence exceeds 15 percent across three consecutive rounds, the bond is slashed and burned, leaving a comet-like slash trail any auditor can trace. A Sybil swarm of 10000 keys would thus need 5 million tokens at risk, roughly 2.3 million dollars, making sockpuppetry a mesa of sunk capital rather than cheap influence.
